project_type: portfolio CMS - Rakhigarhi Ambition Layout Update
summary_of_changes: Implementation guidance for Rakhigarhi 'The Ambition' section: split body into 3 independently editable text boxes (2 on the left column, 1 on the right column), vertically center the right-hand text box, and set the vertical divider (pipe line) height to 70% vertically centered.

typography.heading_h2: font-weight: 300, font-size: 80px (60px on tablet, 40px on mobile), line-height: 1.1
typography.body_text: font-size: 25px (20px desktop small, 18px mobile), font-weight: 300, line-height: 1.5, color: #272e33

layout_and_css_specifications.grid_structure: 2-column grid layout on desktop (`grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) minmax(0, 1fr)`). Left column contains 2 stacked text boxes (`paragraph_1`, `paragraph_2`), right column contains 1 text box (`paragraph_3`).
layout_and_css_specifications.vertical_centering: The right column text box (`paragraph_3`) is vertically centered relative to the left column using `align-self: center` or `display: flex; align-items: center;`.
layout_and_css_specifications.mobile_responsive: On screens <= 700px, collapse grid to 1 column. Vertical line changes to horizontal top border (`border-top: 1px solid #ddd6cf; padding-top: 28px; width: 100%;`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all 3 text boxes (`body_1`, `body_2`, `body_3` or `paragraph_1`, `paragraph_2`, `paragraph_3`) are standard independently editable LiveEditor fields with unique data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='editable-ambition-body-1', data-testid='editable-ambition-body-2', data-testid='editable-ambition-body-3').
Do not modify files or break existing site styling in /app/frontend/src/styles/rakhigarhi-reference.css.
Preserve responsive breakpoint behavior for tablets (<1200px) and mobile (<700px).
All interactive and key text components MUST include kebab-case role-based data-testid attributes.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_and_backgrounds: DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_ai_emojis: NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (e.g. 🤖, 🧠, 💭, 💡) for icons or text.
